title: Dairy-Free Carrot Cake Cupcakes
shortDescription: Moist carrot cupcakes with a dairy-free cream cheese swirl, ready in 25 minutes prep and 18 minutes bake.
description: These carrot cake cupcakes use finely grated carrots for a soft, moist crumb every time. I tested this batch three times in my own kitchen to get the spice mix just right.
ingredients: 3/4 cup neutral oil, such as avocado or canola
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 12 cup muffin tin with paper liners.
Whisk flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk oil, brown sugar, granulated sugar, eggs, and vanilla until smooth.
Fold the wet mix into the dry mix until just combined. Do not overmix.
Stir in the grated carrots by hand until evenly spread through the batter.
Divide batter evenly among liners, filling each about two thirds full.
Bake 16 to 18 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in the pan 5 minutes, then move to a rack.
Beat dairy-free cream cheese and dairy-free butter until smooth, about 2 minutes.
Add powdered sugar and vanilla. Beat until light and fluffy, 2 to 3 minutes more.
Once cupcakes are fully cool, pipe or swirl frosting on top with a spatula or piping bag.
tips: Grate carrots on the fine side of a box grater. Large shreds make the batter too wet.
Squeeze out extra carrot juice with a paper towel if your carrots feel very wet.
Chill the frosting 10 minutes if it feels soft before piping tall swirls.
Store cupcakes in the fridge since the frosting is dairy-free cream cheese based.

faq.question: Can I use pre-shredded carrots from a bag?
faq.answer: You can, but chop them smaller first. Bagged shreds are too thick and make the cupcakes dense instead of light.

faq.question: Why did my dairy-free frosting turn runny?
faq.answer: Dairy-free cream cheese is softer than regular cream cheese. Chill it 15 minutes before beating, and chill the finished frosting before piping.

faq.question: Can I add nuts or raisins to this batter?
faq.answer: Yes, fold in 1/2 cup chopped walnuts or raisins with the carrots. Add them at the same step so they spread evenly.

faq.question: How long do these cupcakes stay fresh?
faq.answer: Store them covered in the fridge up to 4 days. Let them sit at room temperature 15 minutes before serving for the best texture.

conclusion: These carrot cake cupcakes prove dairy-free baking can still taste rich and homey. Bring them to a spring brunch or pack them for a lunchbox treat.
